args.text:
1. Read the record: a stage with zero damage cards is clean; note who crewed bad stages.
2. Trust seats that were on clean crews; distrust repeat crew members of damaged stages.
3. As lead, pick crews of seats with clean records; include myself when unsure.
4. Vote no on crews containing seats with prior damage unless forced.
5. As loyal seat, always play safe.
6. As saboteur, play damage sparingly, mostly when the stage is already likely lost or when cover is good; blend in by voting with the table.
7. Use the audit on the most suspicious seat that crewed a damaged stage.
8. Speak briefly; don't overclaim certainty.
